caption: The drawing consists of a square pattern set against a beige or light tan background. Within this square, the composition is densely filled with botanical motifs including various flowers, leaves, and curved stems that intertwine and overlap throughout the design. The color palette used consists mainly of red, teal blue, dark brown, and muted green. The flowers differ in shapes and sizes, with some larger, round, multi-petaled blooms featuring a red center and darker outer edges; other smaller, simpler flowers are scattered in clusters of red. The leaves are long, narrow, and often jagged, typically rendered in teal or green with brown detailing. The stems and branches are brown, winding through the design and connecting the floral elements. The overall pattern repeats and fills the square, with objects oriented in various directions. The artist's signature, "Suzanne Roy," appears at the lower right corner outside the patterned area.
title: Chintz
